name: Optical Sources, Photometry and Metrology
description: Eye and vision, visual system, sensitivity, acuity, radiometry and photometry; radiometric quantities, instrumentation and measurements. Photometric quantities, instrumentation and measurement system. Integrating sphere and optical bench method. Colorimetry: fundamentals, trichromatic specifications, colorimeters, CIE system, color temperature, color rendering index. Conventional light sources; point and extended sources, tungsten/deuterium halogen lamps, supercontinuum light sources; xenon lamp, laser-based supercontinuum source. Solid state lighting devices; inorganic LEDs, organic/polymeric LEDs (OLEDs and PLEDs), quantum dot based light emitting devices (QLEDs), sunlight harvesting for day light saving, solar concentrators, light guide and transporting systems. Optical detectors: PMTs, MCPs, semiconductor photo-detectors. Detector characteristics and noise consideration, CCD and CMOS detectors. Optical metrology and standards; length, time and frequency standard. Optical radiation standards. Surface inspection, non-destructive testing techniques. Photogrammetry, optical gauging and profiling, fringe projection profilometry using structured light illumination.
